claims: Kim Mulkey is the head women's basketball coach at LSU.
Kim Mulkey has held the position of head women's basketball coach at LSU since April 2021.
Kim Mulkey is a Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Famer.
Kim Mulkey led the Tigers to the 2023 NCAA National Championship.
The 2023 NCAA National Championship marks Kim Mulkey's fourth title as a head coach.
Kim Mulkey is one of the highest-paid coaches in women's basketball.
Kim Mulkey signed a 10-year $36 million extension in 2023.
LSU added assistant coach Gabe Lazo from Tennessee in April 2026.
As of 2026 the LSU team is currently rebuilding for the next season.
The LSU team is focusing on retaining roster talent through the transfer portal.
Kim Mulkey is widely recognized as one of the fastest coaches in Division I history to reach 600 wins.
Kim Mulkey previously coached at Baylor for 21 seasons before moving to LSU
